headline: Why data centers sit at the center of tech backlash
pages: Opposition to data centers has become a political force, and author Paris Marx says it helped drive the Democratic wave in the recent midterm elections. In a TechCrunch interview about his new book Hyperscale, Marx called the data center buildout fundamentally unsustainable. He argues the facilities are an easy target because their effects are physical: higher power bills, strain on water, and noise from rooftop cooling units. He says that cuts across party lines. Marx sees data center opposition as the most visible part of a wider pushback against the physical presence of the tech industry, including Flock cameras, Meta's smart glasses and Waymo's self-driving cars.
The debate is likely to continue as Democrats gain more power in government. Source: TechCrunch.
